summary: Frontend-only retest of USP India homepage cinematic redesign after iteration_5 fixes. All 3 targeted fixes verified via Playwright with wait_for_function on client render. Hero is now flush under the header (0px gap). Dark 'What Takes Shape' manifesto band renders with correct dark background and WHITE serif heading. Hero scrim is denser and ochre eyebrow + white Cormorant H1 are legible. All home sections present, no horizontal overflow at 1440px or 390px, all regression routes return 200.

fix2_dark_manifesto_band.heading_text: The Value Can Extend Beyond the Initiative.

fix3_hero_scrim.h1_text: What We Inherit. What We Create. What We Carry Forward.
